name: qr-to-windows-11
description: Scan QR codes on your phone, receive them instantly on your Windows 11 desktop.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/relay-core
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run package -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
